title: Great Idea!
text: Great Idea!. These bands for organizing linens is a great idea! It has made it so much easier and nicer to keep our linens together. It keeps whole sets together. The bands are sturdy and I have no doubts that they will last for a very long time. This is one step towards organizing our linen closet!

product_metadata.title: ECOHomes Bed Sheet Organizer and Storage Label Bands | Sheets Set Organizers for Linen Closet - Elastic Bedding Sheet Keepers Straps for Foldable Bedsheet, Pillow Case, Duvet (Queen 4PCs Pack | Cream)
features: 🛌 FIND YOUR SHEETS EASILY - ECOHomes’ bedsheet organizers and storage bands help you to easily identify your bedsheets, duvets and bedding sets! You no longer have to waste time figuring out the correct bedsheet, not to mention folding and storing them up again!

🛌 BED SHEET ORGANIZER FOR LINEN CLOSET - Pack of 4 pieces QUEEN bed sheets organizer bands in the top selling cream color. With these sheet keepers, you can tidy up your linen closet and have more space for sheet storage too

🛌 EASY TO USE - Fold your own bed sheets, pillow cases, protectors, mattress pads, duvets and linens as usual. Simply wrap around these easily identifiable sheet label bedding bands. Labeling and identifying your sheet sets have never been easier!

🛌 STRETCHABLE AND DURABLE - Strong elasticity ensures that it won’t sag over time. These stretchy bed sheet storage bands are perfect to store and identify bed sheets, pillow cases, duvets, blankets, towels and more!

🛌 QUALITY MATERIAL - Comes in 4 sizes of KING, QUEEN, TWIN and FULL, or a mixed pack of 8 Pieces. Made from thick elastic band with high quality prints, use the bed sheets organizers and save yourself from piles of messy foldable bed sheets!
